source.sql: SELECT PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, PLANT_TYPE, REGION_LABEL FROM VEDANTA_POC.DIM_PLANT WHERE PLANT_ID <> 'ALL_PLANTS' ORDER BY PLANT_ID; SELECT MATERIAL_GROUP, BASE_UOM FROM VEDANTA_POC.REF_MATERIAL_GROUP ORDER BY MATERIAL_GROUP; SELECT CRITICALITY, SERVICE_LEVEL_PCT FROM VEDANTA_POC.REF_CRITICALITY ORDER BY CRITICALITY; SELECT MATERIAL_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS N FROM VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL GROUP BY MATERIAL_TYPE ORDER BY MATERIAL_TYPE; SELECT DISTINCT MOVEMENT_CLASS, INVENTORY_STATUS, AS_OF_DATE FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION ORDER BY 1,2 (query_preview, <=100 rows, not synced)
SELECT POSTING_MONTH AS MONTH, PLANT_ID, KPI_CODE, KPI_VALUE, KPI_UOM, SCENARIO_LABEL AS SCENARIO FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY ORDER BY POSTING_MONTH, PLANT_ID, KPI_CODE, SCENARIO_LABEL

SELECT IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, DM.CRITICALITY, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, IC.ABC_CLASS, COUNT(*) AS MATERIALS, SUM(IC.AVAILABLE_QTY) AS AVAILABLE_QTY, SUM(IC.INVENTORY_VALUE_INR) AS VALUE_INR FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION IC JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL DM ON DM.MATERIAL_ID = IC.MATERIAL_ID WHERE DM.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') AND IC.PLANT_ID IN ('HZL_DEMO_01','HZL_DEMO_02','HZL_DEMO_03','HZL_DEMO_04','HZL_DEMO_05','HZL_DEMO_06') GROUP BY IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, DM.CRITICALITY, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, IC.ABC_CLASS ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

SELECT IC.MATERIAL_ID, IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, DM.CRITICALITY, IC.ABC_CLASS, IC.XYZ_CLASS, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS, SUM(IC.AVAILABLE_QTY) AS AVAILABLE_QTY, SUM(IC.INVENTORY_VALUE_INR) AS VALUE_INR, MAX(IC.DAYS_ON_HAND) AS DAYS_ON_HAND, MAX(IC.DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION) AS DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION, MAX(IC.SAFETY_STOCK_QTY) AS SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, MAX(IC.REORDER_POINT_QTY) AS REORDER_POINT_QTY, MAX(IC.MAX_STOCK_QTY) AS MAX_STOCK_QTY, MAX(IC.TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY) AS TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY FROM VEDANTA_POC.INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION IC JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL DM ON DM.MATERIAL_ID = IC.MATERIAL_ID WHERE DM.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') AND IC.PLANT_ID IN ('HZL_DEMO_01','HZL_DEMO_02','HZL_DEMO_03','HZL_DEMO_04','HZL_DEMO_05','HZL_DEMO_06') GROUP BY IC.MATERIAL_ID, IC.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, DM.CRITICALITY, IC.ABC_CLASS, IC.XYZ_CLASS, IC.MOVEMENT_CLASS, IC.INVENTORY_STATUS ORDER BY IC.MATERIAL_ID, IC.PLANT_ID

SELECT R.RECOMMENDATION_ID, R.MATERIAL_ID, R.PLANT_ID, DM.MATERIAL_GROUP, DM.MATERIAL_TYPE, DM.CRITICALITY, R.PRIORITY, R.RECOMMENDED_PR_DATE, R.RECOMMENDED_QTY, R.ESTIMATED_VALUE_INR, R.AVAILABLE_QTY, R.OPEN_PR_QTY, R.OPEN_PO_QTY, R.SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, R.REORDER_POINT_QTY, R.RECOMMENDATION_REASON AS REASON, R.SHUTDOWN_ID FROM VEDANTA_POC.REORDER_RECOMMENDATION R JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL DM ON DM.MATERIAL_ID = R.MATERIAL_ID WHERE DM.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') AND R.PLANT_ID IN ('HZL_DEMO_01','HZL_DEMO_02','HZL_DEMO_03','HZL_DEMO_04','HZL_DEMO_05','HZL_DEMO_06') ORDER BY R.RECOMMENDATION_ID

SELECT CALENDAR_MONTH AS MONTH, PLANT_ID, MATERIAL_GROUP, MATERIAL_TYPE, SHUTDOWN_DRIVEN, PLAN_VALUE_INR, ACTUAL_PO_VALUE_INR, ACTUAL_GR_VALUE_INR, VARIANCE_INR, VARIANCE_PCT FROM VEDANTA_POC.BUSINESS_PLAN_VS_ACTUAL WHERE PLANT_ID IN ('HZL_DEMO_01','HZL_DEMO_02','HZL_DEMO_03','HZL_DEMO_04','HZL_DEMO_05','HZL_DEMO_06') AND MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') ORDER BY CALENDAR_MONTH, PLANT_ID, MATERIAL_GROUP, MATERIAL_TYPE, SHUTDOWN_DRIVEN
